mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE prefix_lengths(n) AS ( SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM prefix_lengths WHERE n < CHAR_LENGTH(CONVERT(#{normalizedCode} USING utf8mb4)) AND n < 64 ) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM prefix_lengths WHERE LEFT(CONVERT(#{normalizedCode} USING utf8mb4), n) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci = CONVERT(#{reservedPrefix} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci )
